title: Modonome Risk Surface Guard suppression allowlist
description: Spec of record: docs/risk-surface-guard.md, "Suppressing a finding"; ADR-047 decision 9. Base-branch-loaded suppression list for scripts/risk-surface-guard.mjs. An entry added by a pull request does not affect that same pull request's own scan: see scripts/lib/risk-surface-allowlist.mjs and the base-pin checkout in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

id.description: A short, unique, human-chosen identifier for this entry, e.g. RSAL-001.

rule.description: The rule id this entry suppresses, e.g. RS106.

file.description: The finding's file path this entry applies to. Supports the same glob syntax as PROTECTED_PATH_GLOBS in scripts/lib/risk-surface-rules.mjs (** for any depth, * within a path segment); a literal path with no wildcard matches exactly.

reason.description: Why this finding is a false positive or an accepted risk here.

added_by.description: Who added this entry, for audit purposes.

expires_at.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Required: suppression is always time-boxed and must be re-justified on expiry, never permanent by default.
